# DataBard — agent integration guide

DataBard is an AI data analyst: connect a source, get health scores, trend
narratives, and a 2-minute audio briefing. No email, no sales call — self-serve.
The A2MCP endpoints below are the canonical integration surface (health check,
briefing, probe); marketplace listing status can change independently.

## Direct integration (preferred — no credentials needed to try)

- Service discovery: `GET /api/mcp/tools`
- Free demo analysis: `POST /api/mcp/health-check` with `{"demo":true}`
- Live analysis: `POST /api/mcp/health-check` with a connection spec, e.g.
  `{"source":"datahub","schemaFqn":"db.sales","datahub":{"serverUrl":"http://your-datahub:8080"}}`
- Full briefing (script + audio, $1/call x402 on X Layer):
  `POST /api/mcp/briefing` with the same connection spec
- Write findings back to DataHub: `POST /api/mcp/writeback`
- Probe agent-service quality (free preview, no payment):
  `POST /api/probe/preview` with `{}` — add `{"stream": true}` for live NDJSON progress
- Probe agent-service quality (paid, $0.25/call x402 on X Layer, optional on-chain verdict):
  `POST /api/agent/probe` with `{}` or `{"attest": true}`

Every paid tool returns a decision-ready payload: `summary` (quotable
takeaway), `keyFindings` (short strings), `nextStep` (single recommended
action), plus a `cost` receipt. Unreachable services are reported honestly —
never scored as if they responded.

Sources: openmetadata, dbt-cloud, dbt-local, the-graph, dune, coral, datahub, monid.
Omit everything for a labelled demo — every invocation succeeds with `demo:true`.

## In-browser agents (WebMCP)

Pages expose `databard_runDemoHealthCheck`, `databard_getTools`, and
`databard_startConnect` via `document.modelContext` when the browser supports
WebMCP (Chromium 146+ with #enable-webmcp-testing). Same tools as above,
tab-bound transport.

## Probe Receipts — BNB Chain validation (pre-deployment)

Canonical single-shot Probe evidence artifacts are under `/probe/receipts/`;
the machine-readable manifest is `/probe/receipts/manifest.json`. Current MCP
artifacts measure `tools/list` interface health only: they do not invoke tools
or prove tool-output correctness. These are measurement artifacts only. No BNB
`ProbeReceiptRegistry` contract address has been published yet — do not send a
transaction based on this file, and do not treat this as BNB x402 support.
When deployed, this section will carry the exact verified contract address and
`requestProbe` calldata instructions.

## Humans

- Try the demo: `/` → demo CTA
- Connect a source: `/?start=connect`
- Weekly league: `/league` · Earn economy: `/superteam` · Verify: `/verify`
